State of New Hampshire 
PUBLIC 
EMPLOYEE 
LABOR RELATIONS 
BOARD 
HAVERHILL COOPERATIVE EDUCATION 
* 
ASSOCIATION, NEA-N.H. 
Complainant 
V. 
NORMAN MULLEN, SUPERINTENDENT, 
SAU 823 
Respondent 
CASE NO. T-0232:14 
DECISION NO. 85-87 
ORDER DISMISSING COMPLAINT 
Pursuant to written notification from the representative for 
the complainant stating the complainant wishes to withdraw the unfair 
labor practice charge filed against Norman Mullen, Superintendent, SAU #23 
relative to his refusal to abide by orders respecting back pay due and 
owing Barry LeBarron and Irving Fountain, it is 
ORDERED that this complaint be and the same hereby is, dismissed 
without prejudice. 
Dated this 1st day of November, 1985. 
Robert E. CRAIG, Chairman
